blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ACEN Corp., the power arm of the Ayala Group, has secured fresh capital of 50 million euros, or about P3.5 billion, from a Dutch banking giant for its renewables projects. In a regulatory filing on Tuesday, the company said it had signed a term loan facility with ING Bank, N.V., Manila Branch. ING Bank N.V., Singapore Branch, acted as agent for the transaction. READ: ACEN, Dutch investor push India collab The group announced that it will use the new funds to finance and refinance investments in existing and future renewable energy projects through its subsidiaries and joint ventures.
